name: Quartz Hill Towne Centre
summary: Quartz Hill Towne Centre is a community shopping center in Lancaster, California, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. With a 4.3-star rating and convenient daily hours, it serves as a neighborhood hub for essential retail and dining needs in the Quartz Hill area.
demographics: Quartz Hill Towne Centre serves the Lancaster and Quartz Hill communities in northern Los Angeles County, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals. The trade area consists of suburban households with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient neighborhood shopping. Visitors typically prioritize value-oriented shopping with a focus on everyday necessities, groceries, and family dining options, reflecting the practical needs of the surrounding residential communities.
description: Quartz Hill Towne Centre is a community-focused shopping destination located at 4033 West Avenue L in Lancaster, California, serving the growing Quartz Hill area of northern Los Angeles County. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, this center provides essential retail and dining options for local residents and families. The center has earned a strong reputation in the community with a 4.3-star rating from over 1,300 reviews, reflecting its commitment to serving neighborhood needs. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Quartz Hill Towne Centre offers convenient access to everyday shopping and services in a welcoming open-air environment. As part of Phillips Edison's portfolio of neighborhood shopping centers, the property emphasizes accessibility, community connection, and a tenant mix designed to meet the daily needs of the surrounding residential areas.
